hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | grep -q '/libs/contract/' && { echo 'libs/contract is generated. Edit specs/*.tsp and run: mise run generate' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -E -q '(^|&&|;|\|\|)[[:space:]]*git push[^|;&]*(--force|[[:space:]]-f([[:space:]]|$)|[[:space:]:/](main|master)([[:space:]]|$))' && { echo 'Never push to main or force-push. Push a feature branch and open a PR (see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md).' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null && exit 0; mise run check >&2 || { echo 'mise run check failed: fix before finishing' >&2; exit 2; }
